# FG-DOC-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_claim_held_by_another_person_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この文書は別の人が編集中です。編集の宣言が切れるか、解除されるまで待ってください。
- en: Someone else is editing this document. Wait until their edit claim lapses or is released.
- id: Orang lain sedang mengedit dokumen ini. Tunggu sampai klaim edit mereka berakhir atau dilepas.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 13 §7.5 / ADR-0027 §3 (stage 4 part A): the edit claim ("編集中") of a document belongs to another person and has not lapsed. `PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/documents/{doc_id}/edit-claim` (`gstn doc claim`) takes or extends only the caller's own claim or one that lapsed (30 minutes after it was taken or last extended, compared with the database's clock); `DELETE …/edit-claim` (`gstn doc release`) releases only the caller's own. A Maintainer may revoke another person's claim with `POST …/edit-claim/revoke` (`gstn doc release --revoke`, audited `document.edit_claim.revoked`). Nothing was changed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `doc_id`, `holder_id` (the person holding the claim), `expires_at` and `project_id`. `GET …/documents/{doc_id}/status` (`gstn doc status`) shows the claim and when it lapses. Read-only SQL: SELECT doc_id, user_id, merge_request_iid, claimed_at, expires_at, expires_at > now() AS live FROM forge.document_edit_claims WHERE project_id = <id>.

## 対処 (fix)

Wait until the claim lapses, ask its holder to release it, or ask a Maintainer to revoke it (gstn doc release <doc_id> --project <id> --revoke).
